name: Cuppa
description: A cute caffeine tracker: watch your cup fill up through the day, log drinks right from the widget and stay under your daily limit — privately, offline, right on your iPhone.
about: Cuppa turns your daily coffee, tea and other caffeinated drinks into a cup that fills up as the day goes on, so you can see at a glance how close you are to your limit.
features: Log coffee, tea, energy drinks and more from a list of common drinks with typical caffeine values
Set a daily caffeine limit (400 mg by default) and see how much of it you've used
Log a drink in one tap from the Home Screen widget, without opening the app
Create your own drinks and recipes
History of every day and the days you went over the limit
Pro: advanced stats with monthly and quarterly trends, favourite drinks, time of day, calories and an estimate of the caffeine in your body
price: Free, with optional Pro as a monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.
